lines.say: Are squats bad for your knees?
People say deep squats destroy your knees. Research says the opposite.
Reviews found deep squats don't damage healthy knees. The forces are well within what knees can handle.
Squatting makes the muscles and tendons around your knee stronger, and that protects it.
Letting your knees go past your toes is normal. Stopping them puts more stress on your hips and lower back.
What does hurt: too much weight too soon, bad form, or ignoring pain.
Verdict: myth. If your knees hurt, lower the weight, check your form, and see a physio if it doesn't go away.
